description: Select the lowest-cost fully verified immediate route for one explicit economic objective. Compares only semantically compatible products, keeps unknown costs unknown, and never signs, funds, bridges, or submits an order.

instrument.description: Instrument, e.g. BTC, NVDA, lighter:ETH, option:BTC-20260711-70000-C, pm:<slug>.

size_usd.description: Dollar notional to spend or trade.
